The '''Zarracina system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[11,660 BBY]], during the [[Pius Dea Era|Pius Dea period]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zarracina III]].
